test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the one-word substitute from the passage for the given group of words.

Rapid or sudden rise
solution:
The correct answer is Upsurge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's consider each option-

 
 
• Caravans- A vehicle equipped for living in, typically towed by a car and used for holidays.
 
• Ousted- Drive out or expel (someone) from a position or place.
 
• Upsurge- An **upward surge in the strength** or quantity of something; an increase. 
 
• Ancient- Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'upsurge' is the most appropriate one word substitute for the group of words 'rapid or sudden rise'.
 
• Thus option 3 is the correct answer.
